risk: Unauthorized vehicle entry at main gate
cause: Manual paper gate log; no plate recognition
consequence: Theft or sabotage inside the yard
existing_controls: Guard at gate; paper visitor log
mitigation: Install ANPR camera with pre-registered vehicle list and barrier interlock

risk: Perimeter fence breach on north side
cause: Poor lighting and no camera coverage on north fence
mitigation: Add LED flood lighting and 2 CCTV cameras; patrol every 2 hours

risk: CCTV blind spots at loading docks 4-6
cause: Camera layout not updated after dock extension
consequence: Loading incidents and theft cannot be investigated
mitigation: Install 3 cameras on docks 4-6 with 30-day retention

risk: Access card sharing and tailgating at staff entrance
cause: Single swing door with no turnstile
existing_controls: Access cards issued to all staff
mitigation: Install turnstiles and run a monthly access card audit

risk: Cargo theft or hijack during night transit
cause: Night runs on remote routes with long stops
consequence: Loss of cargo and risk to driver safety
mitigation: Journey management plan with no-stop zones; 60-minute check-in calls; panic button

risk: Driver fatigue on long-haul routes
cause: Back-to-back shifts and no rest rules
mitigation: Set maximum driving hours and mandatory rest stops; fatigue checks at dispatch

risk: Vehicle breakdown from missed preventive maintenance
cause: Service planned by date only and repeat faults not tracked
consequence: Missed deliveries and higher repair cost
mitigation: PM schedule by kilometres and engine hours; repeat-fault tracking log

risk: Fuel misuse or fraud
cause: Shared fuel cards and no per-vehicle consumption review
consequence: Higher fuel cost and budget overrun
mitigation: Individual fuel cards and a monthly per-vehicle variance report

risk: Insider theft of high-value stock
cause: High-value items stored in open racking
mitigation: High-value cage with two-person rule; weekly cycle counts

risk: Expired stock issued to clients
cause: FEFO rule not enforced at picking
mitigation: FEFO picking rule in the WMS with 60-day expiry alerts

risk: Forklift and pedestrian collision
cause: Shared aisles and no speed limits
mitigation: Segregated walkways; 8 km/h limit; blue warning lights; refresher training

risk: Fire in battery charging area
cause: Chargers close to stored packaging
mitigation: Thermal detection; 2 m separation zone; monthly charger inspection

risk: Emergency exits blocked by stored pallets
cause: No floor marking and peak-season overflow
mitigation: Floor marking at exits and a daily walk-round checklist

risk: Staff unfamiliar with evacuation procedure
cause: No evacuation drill in the last 12 months
consequence: Confusion and injury during an emergency
mitigation: Quarterly drills with trained floor wardens and assembly point checks

risk: Contract guards deployed without vetting
cause: Contractor supplies staff at short notice
consequence: Insider threat inside the security team
mitigation: Background checks before deployment written into the contractor SLA

risk: Disputes with drivers escalating at the gate
cause: Long queues and unclear gate rules
mitigation: De-escalation training and a written gate procedure

risk: Security contractor fails to deliver service
cause: Single supplier with no exit clause
mitigation: Approve a second vendor and add a 30-day exit clause

risk: Shipment schedules shared on personal messaging apps
cause: No approved channel for operational updates
consequence: Route and cargo details leak to criminals
existing_controls: Verbal instruction to keep schedules private
mitigation: Approved messaging channel with need-to-know distribution lists

risk: Power outage stops the WMS and CCTV
cause: No UPS on servers and cameras
consequence: Loss of visibility and stock control
mitigation: UPS on CCTV and servers; monthly generator load test

risk: Road closures disrupt deliveries
cause: Single route to main clients
mitigation: Pre-approved alternate routes and a client notification protocol
